title: Talk it through 3.2
role: Front-desk manager answering a guest's complaint at check-out
can_do: I can explain a problem and ask for a solution politely.
I can respond to a complaint with an apology and an offer.

nodes.partner_line: Good morning. I'd like to check out, but I have a complaint.
nodes.translation: Buenos días. Quisiera hacer el check-out, pero tengo una queja.

options.text: Of course. I'm sorry to hear that. What happened?
Certainly. Please tell me about it.
I'm sorry. How can I help you?

nodes.partner_line: The room was very noisy at night and nobody helped us.
nodes.translation: La habitación fue muy ruidosa por la noche y nadie nos ayudó.
nodes.model_reply: I'm very sorry about the noise. I apologize.

nodes.partner_line: I called the front desk twice, and nothing happened.
nodes.translation: Llamé a la recepción dos veces y no pasó nada.

options.text: That is unacceptable. I'll speak to the night team.
I understand why you are upset. We should have moved you.
I see. I will make a note of this.

nodes.partner_line: What can you do to solve this?

options.text: We can offer you a ten percent discount.
We can take one night off the bill.
We can give you a free breakfast for your next stay.

nodes.partner_line: A discount sounds fair, but I'd like to talk to the manager.
nodes.translation: Un descuento suena justo, pero me gustaría hablar con el gerente.

options.text: Of course. I'll call the manager now.
Certainly. She will be here in two minutes.
I understand. Please take a seat.

nodes.partner_line: Thank you. I appreciate your help.

options.text: Thank you for your patience. Have a safe trip.
You're welcome. We hope to see you again.
